blocks.text: Solid ke atoms, molecules ya ions bohat qareeb qareeb bhare hote hain; gas ki tarah yeh mazeed qareeb nahi aa sakte. Metallic solids mein atoms gend (sphere) jaise gol hote hain. Aise particles ko tarteeb dene se hexagonal aur cubic close-packed structures bante hain. In mein particles ki bahar ki hadein ek doosre ko chhoo rahi hoti hain, magar gol hone ki wajah se woh 74% se zyada jagah nahi bhar sakte. Matlab solid ko mazeed dabana (compress karna) mumkin nahi.

Expansion woh property hai jis mein particles ke darmiyan jagah barhti hai. Solids mein kashish ki forces itni mazboot hain ke temperature barhane se bhi particles ki jagahen mushkil se badalti hain. Solid ke particles apni ausat jagah (mean position) ke gird larazte (vibrate karte) hain. Is liye garam karne se solid ka volume bohat kam barhta hai. Solids ke linear aur cubic expansion ke coefficients hote to hain, magar liquids aur gases ke muqable mein na hone ke barabar.
iii) Solids mein particles ki harkat

Solid ke particles na ek jagah se doosri jagah jate hain (translatory motion), na ghoomte hain (rotational motion). Woh sirf apni ausat jagah ke gird larazte hain. Temperature barhne par yeh larazna tez ho jata hai.

Solids mein particles ke darmiyan jagah liquids se bohat kam hai, kyunke un ki forces zyada mazboot hain. Qareeb qareeb bhare atoms, molecules aur ions ki wajah se solids aam taur par sakht hote hain, un ke melting points oonche hote hain aur woh bohat stable (mustahkam) hote hain.

Solids mein particles (atoms, ions, molecules) ionic, covalent, metallic ya van der Waals forces se jure hote hain. Yeh forces itni mazboot hain ke particles ko apni jagah par jama deti hain; particles sirf apni ausat jagah ke gird laraz sakte hain.
vi) KMT ke mutabiq kinetic energy
Kinetic energy particles ki harkat se aati hai. Solid ke particles sirf larazte hain; na translational harkat karte hain na rotational. Is liye solid ke paas sirf vibrational kinetic energy hoti hai.

items: Solids: compression nahi (close packing, gol particles zyada se zyada 74% jagah), expansion na hone ke barabar, sirf vibration (na translatory na rotational), particles ke darmiyan sab se kam jagah, ionic/covalent/metallic/van der Waals forces, sirf vibrational kinetic energy.
